name: google-cloud
description: Google through its CLIs: gcloud (projects, Cloud Storage, artifact publishing), the Google Workspace CLI gws (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Tasks, People), OpenAI's connected Gmail workflows, and YouTube playlists through ytx.

interface.longDescription: Reach Google through its CLIs rather than curated connectors: discover Google Cloud projects, operate Cloud Storage within its write boundaries, and publish artifacts with gcloud; use OpenAI's connected Gmail app and workflows with raw Gmail access, attachments, bounded attention review, and read-only inbox hygiene through the Google Workspace CLI (gws); and read and edit YouTube playlists, liked videos, and subscriptions through the quota-aware ytx CLI.
defaultPrompt: Publish this screenshot and give me the URL
What Google Cloud projects do I have?
Triage my Gmail inbox into actionable buckets
List my YouTube playlists with ytx
